title: 第五十二章 山地精与熊人族下第五十一章 山地精与熊人族上
lines: 西隆在旁边踱步，沉默的打量着几个山地精，没有说话。
山地精确实不是地精，形象更像是熊地精的近亲，却没有熊地精那样魁梧，身高普遍在一米六左右，皮肤土黄，手臂瘦长，野猪般的獠牙外突，头鬃被随意编成细辫乱在脑后。
西隆看着他们的衣装武器，发现都是粗麻兽皮、石矛骨刀。
钴龙一番直白强硬的话说完，山地精战士明显警惕起来，灰白色的长指甲贴住了刀柄。
唯独亚兹还保持着平静：“如果真龙想要巡视我们的族群，我们当然欢迎，不过，蛮骨部落并没有什么营地，我们的族人散落在峡谷台地之间，靠双脚奔跑和岩壁攀登连接往来。”
“我们也可以狩猎一些野兽招待真龙。”
他看着壮如小山的钴龙，摇了摇头：“但是，确实没有牛羊。”
克莱利觉得有些不满了，从鼻孔里喷出两道白气，站立起来，长达七米的身躯直压到山地精头顶，而西隆只是在旁边平静看着。
“你们只是表面恭顺，心里抗拒。”
克莱利用深黑的竖眼俯视：“如果是其他巨龙领主前来，想必得到的会是另外一番答复，你是认为我们还未长成大龙所以可以欺瞒么？还是想用山地精的头骨，衡量一下我们身体里的力量？”
“蛮骨氏族绝无那样的胆量。”
亚兹深深俯身。
地面传来微微的震动，幼龙和山地精都转头看去，一片灰色的巨影疾奔而来，四足飞驰，步幅跨度极大，几乎转眼就扑近到了面前。
“熊人族。”
亚兹眯起眼睛，默默退到一边，幼龙们也感受到了威胁，摆出警戒的姿态，喉咙微微颤动着。
约莫只有二十头熊人，狂奔起来却有种军队冲锋的气势，直到接近幼龙之后，它们才纷纷停下，接着站立起来，个个高逾两米，雄健非常，身上的长毛在风中起落。
“统治荒野大地的主人啊，您忠诚的熊人部族前来觐见。”
熊人们解下挂在后背的武器，放在一边，原本站立起来的身躯重又伏下，硕大的头颅贴向地面，如同朝拜，半晌都不曾再动一下。
西隆依旧和莫奇凑在一起，在后面拨弄湖水。
克莱利看着解除武装、贴伏地面的熊人，又瞥一眼旁边的山地精，看见没有，这才叫做恭顺。
他昂起头来，依旧还是正宗的铁龙腔调：“熊人，你们前来觐见，是有什么要说？”
“我们赶来聆听主人的命令，满心热烈的渴望向您效劳。”
其中一名熊人低伏脊背，向前走了一段。
“家族要重拾对风吟台地的控制，我要你们的忠诚，你们应当举着氏族的仪仗，带我巡视你们的营地。”克莱利说。
“这是理所当然的事。”
熊人说：“今年的鳞税我们已经准备好了，如果需要征召奴隶和苦工，请主人对我们下令，氏族也会尽快清点出来。”
他顿了一下，意识到这些幼龙并不只是来征鳞税、抓苦工的，于是回忆了一阵，又接着开口。
“我们的头领沃姆说，风吟台地并不安稳，夜间有许多大型异怪活动，还有一些氏族，对家族存在着严重的反叛情绪，可能心怀不轨。”
熊人说：“为了维护主人的威严和安全，我们邀请您前往熊人族的营寨，熊人族并不是什么强大富裕的部族，但如果主人降临落下，我们会向您献上最好的蜜酒、鲜肉和美人。”
莫奇听完，明显有些心动，把湖水踩得哗哗作响。
旁边的山地精都握着武器，亚兹微眯起眼，冷冷注视恭恭敬敬的熊人。
一些熊人察觉到他的目光，喉咙里发出意味不明的闷声，亚兹的目光垂了下去。
克莱利也在打量那些熊人，在他强劲气势的威压之下，熊人们依旧伏低身躯趴着，身体一丝一毫也没有颤动。
content_en:
Shillong was pacing next to them, looking at the mountain elves silently and saying nothing.
Mountain goblins are indeed not goblins. They look more like close relatives of bugbears, but they are not as tall as bugbears. They are generally about 1.6 meters tall, with sallow skin, long and thin arms, wild boar-like tusks protruding, and the manes of their heads are randomly braided into thin braids at the back of their heads.
Shillong looked at their clothes and weapons and found that they were all made of coarse linen animal skins, stone spears and bone knives.
After Cobalt Dragon finished speaking bluntly and forcefully, the mountain goblin warrior became visibly alert, his long gray-white nails sticking to the handle of the knife.
Only Yaz remained calm: "If the real dragon wants to inspect our tribe, of course we welcome it. However, the Barbarian Bone Tribe does not have any camps. Our tribe is scattered among the canyon terraces, and they rely on running on their feet and climbing rock walls to communicate."
"We can also hunt some beasts to entertain the real dragon."
He looked at the cobalt dragon, which was as strong as a hill, and shook his head: "But there are indeed no cattle or sheep."
Clary felt a little dissatisfied, and blew out two streams of white air from his nostrils, stood up, and pressed his seven-meter-long body directly on top of the mountain goblin's head, while Shillong just watched calmly.
"You are just being submissive on the surface but resisting in your heart."
Clary looked down with dark vertical eyes: "If other dragon lords come, they will definitely get a different answer. Do you think we can deceive us because we haven't grown into dragons yet? Or do you want to use the skulls of mountain goblins to measure the power in our bodies?"
"The Barbarian Bone Clan would never have that kind of courage."
Yaz leaned deeply.
There was a slight vibration on the ground, and both the young dragon and the mountain goblin turned their heads to look. A giant gray shadow rushed towards them. It was flying on all fours, with a huge stride, and it was almost in front of them in the blink of an eye.
"Werebears."
Yaz narrowed his eyes and silently stepped aside. The young dragons also felt the threat and assumed a vigilant posture, their throats trembling slightly.
There were only about twenty bear men, and they ran wildly with the momentum of an army charging. It was not until they got close to the young dragon that they stopped one after another, and then stood up. They were all over two meters tall and very muscular, with their long hair rising and falling in the wind.
"Master who rules the wild lands, your loyal tribe of Ursines come to pay homage to you."
The bears took off the weapons hanging on their backs and put them aside. The originally standing bodies fell down again, and their huge heads were pressed to the ground, as if they were worshiping. They did not move for a long time.
Shillong and Mochi were still together, playing with the lake water from behind.
Clary looked at the disarmed Ursine lying on the ground, and then glanced at the mountain goblin next to him to see if he saw it. This is called submission.
He raised his head and said in his authentic Iron Dragon accent: "Bear Man, what do you have to say when you come to see me?"
"We have come to listen to our master's orders and are filled with a passionate desire to serve you."
One of the bear men lowered his back and walked forward for a while.
"The family wants to regain control of the Wind Song Terrace. I want your loyalty. You should hold up the clan's guard of honor and take me to inspect your camp." Clery said.
"It's a given."
The bear man said: "We have prepared this year's scale tax. If we need to recruit slaves and hard labor, please master, please give us an order, and the clan will count them out as soon as possible."
He paused and realized that these young dragons were not just here to collect taxes and catch hard workers, so he recalled for a while and then continued.
"Our leader Worm said that the Wind Song Terrace is not stable. There are many large-scale abnormal activities at night. There are also some clans that are seriously rebellious against the family and may have evil intentions."
The bear man said: "In order to maintain the majesty and safety of the master, we invite you to the camp of the bear men. The bear men are not a powerful and wealthy tribe, but if the master comes and falls, we will offer you the best honey wine, fresh meat and beauties."
After hearing this, Mo Qi was obviously a little moved, and the water in the lake made a splash.
The mountain goblins next to him were all holding weapons. Yaz narrowed his eyes slightly and stared coldly at the respectful bear man.
Some of the werebears noticed his gaze, making unexplained muffled sounds in their throats, and Yaz lowered his eyes.
Clary was also sizing up the bears. Under the pressure of his strong momentum, the bears still lay low and their bodies did not tremble at all.
